Who are we, and what do we do?




ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt Ltd) is India’s largest homegrown social media 
company and the only local player to achieve profitability in the industry, 
with 200+ million Monthly Monetizable Users across all its platforms.




Founded in 2015, ShareChat has social media brands such as the ShareChat App 
and Moj App and micro drama app QuickTV under its portfolio. QuickTV, the 
newest addition to ShareChat's family of apps, crossed the 10 million downloads 
mark within 3 months of launch and currently has 60Mn MAUs across the network 
viewing the vertical episodic content. 




Today, the ShareChat network maintains a whopping 1,000 Cr ARR and is India’s 
leading social media platform servicing users across the country in 15 regional 
languages. This growth has led to a 28% YoY revenue growth in the July-Sept 
(2025-26) quarter and increased it by more than 60% in the Oct-Dec quarter.







What You’ll Do?


 * As an Audio Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical 
and creative sound quality of all micro-drama episodes before release.
 * Realistic AI Voice over generation and creative BGM and SFX generation that 
aligns with the tonality of the series and makes for an interesting 
storytelling experience.
 * Collaborate with writers and creative directors, to translate creative 
ideas into striking AI-driven stories.
 * Conduct end-to-end Quality Checks for audio/BGM/SFX of all episodes before 
delivery.
 * Monitor audio levels and maintain balance across episodes.
 * Identify and resolve technical glitches such as compression errors, drop 
frames, and subtitle sync issues.
 * Analyze feedback and quickly deliver multiple refined versions optimized 
for platform performance and audience response.
 * Contribute to the development of prompt engineering and prompting techniques
 * Conduct research and experiments based on latest advancements in generative 
AI and develop insights to enhance the quality and efficiency of generated audio


Who You Are?

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿


 * Prior Sound engineering experience in OTT platforms, television, or film 
post-production.
 * Strong knowledge of Sound Design, BGM & SFX
 * Strong understanding of AI generated voice over and AI workflows
 * Keen eye for detail, with a passion for ensuring premium-quality content.
 * Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.





Where you’ll be?

Location - Remote




What’s In It For You?





 * At ShareChat, our values—Ownership, Speed, User Empathy, Integrity, and 
First Principles—are at the core of our ways of working. We believe in hiring 
top talent and grooming future leaders by providing a flexible environment to 
aid growth and development.

What does the team do ? 




At ShareChat, India’s largest vernacular content platform, the Content 
Operations team plays a pivotal role in defining and executing strategies for 
creating and acquiring impactful content, driving monetization efforts, and 
contributing to overall business growth. Collaborating with creators, partners, 
product teams, and feed teams, the team ensures the delivery of high-quality, 
engaging content that resonates with diverse Indian audiences across multiple 
formats, including audio and video.




What You’ll Do?


 * Use AI tools to generate, design, and edit visual content — including 
AI-created images, character shots, and video scenes — to craft powerful, 
emotionally engaging microdramas, ensuring continuity and smoothness of content.
 * Shot-by-shot breakdown of scripts, characters, backgrounds to be used for 
AI prompts
 * Collaborate with writers and creative directors, to translate creative 
ideas into visually striking AI-driven stories.
 * Maintain consistency in visual identity, tone, and messaging across all 
content formats.
 * Analyze feedback and quickly deliver multiple refined versions optimized 
for platform performance and audience response.
 * Contribute to the development of prompt engineering and prompting techniques
 * Conduct research and experiments based on latest advancements in generative 
AI and develop insights to enhance the quality and efficiency of generated 
videos
 * Contribute innovative ideas and creative solutions to enhance team processes


Who You Are?


 * 3-6+ months of experience in AI video content generation, video editing, or 
filmmaking. Freshers with strong creative foundations (film, animation, media, 
design, VFX or similar) are welcome to apply.
 * Hands-on with at least one creative tool: AI tools (e.g., Runway, 
Midjourney, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, or similar), editing software 
(e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut), or photo 
editing/graphic design tools.
 * A portfolio of your own work: AI-generated content, video edits, short 
films, ad films, or college projects.
 * Basic understanding of shot types, framing, and shot planning (core to 
role).
 * Strong storytelling instinct and an eye for cinematic composition and 
detail.
 * Fluent written and spoken English, with a good feel for US tone and 
dialogue.
 * Familiarity with English films, web series, or microdrama genres is a plus
 * Familiarity with post-production workflows (editing, sound, VFX, Excel) is 
a plus.
 * Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-output environments, and adapting 
to evolving creative briefs and technology.


Where you’ll be?

Location - Remote




What’s In It For You?





 * At ShareChat, our values—Ownership, Speed, User Empathy, Integrity, and 
First Principles—are at the core of our ways of working. We believe in hiring 
top talent and grooming future leaders by providing a flexible environment to 
aid growth and development.

Who are we and What we do:

 

ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt Ltd) is India’s largest homegrown social media 
company and the only local player to achieve profitability in the industry, 
with 200+ million Monthly Monetizable Users across all its platforms.

 

Founded in 2015, ShareChat has social media brands such as the ShareChat App 
and Moj App and micro drama app QuickTV under its portfolio. QuickTV, the 
newest addition to ShareChat's family of apps, crossed the 10 million downloads 
mark within 3 months of launch and currently has 60Mn MAUs across the network 
viewing the vertical episodic content.

 

Today, the ShareChat network maintains a whopping 1,000 Cr ARR and is India’s 
leading social media platform servicing users across the country in 15 regional 
languages. This growth has led to a 28% YoY revenue growth in the July-Sept 
(2025-26) quarter and increased it by more than 60% in the Oct-Dec quarter.

 

What does the team do?

This team works with some of the top FMCG companies to help them achieve 
their brand tasks through Sharechat Network's advertising solutions. They 
consult the brand and the media teams drive the best efficiency and 
effectiveness for their brands.

 

What You’ll Do?





 * Proven ability to independently run some of our largest, most demanding 
accounts in FMCG, with the seniority and polish to hold CXO-level relationships 
and drive professional outreach without needing support from above.
 * Built as an individual-contributor seat in our flat structure, this role 
gives you direct ownership of marquee accounts from day one.
 * Ability to develop relationships with FMCG clients' media and brand teams 
and the media agency planners.
 * Data driven with excellent storytelling skills, must articulate business 
solutions in an insightful manner.
 * Responsible for selling display, video and content driven sales solutions 
for revenue generation.
 * Design and implement a strategic sales plan that goes deep in building 
strategic value 
 * Ability to act as an advisor to clients drive business 

 Who are you?


 * 9+ years of digital sales experience, previous experience with FMCG clients 
is an advantage.
 * You think and solution at the brand level — going beyond pitching media 
plans to genuinely shaping brand strategy and creative problem-solving for the 
client.
 * Excellent communication and negotiation skills
 * Ability to excel at consultative selling
 * Experience working with brand stakeholders, both internal and external. 

Where you’ll be?

Mumbai

 

What’s In It For You?

 

At ShareChat, our values—Ownership, Speed, User Empathy, Integrity, and First 
Principles—are at the core of our ways of working. We believe in hiring top 
talent and grooming future leaders by providing a flexible environment to aid 
growth and development.

Our Elite Benefits Suite:

Wealth & Security: ESOPs and comprehensive insurance coverage.

Lifestyle: Hybrid working culture, Gym allowance, and Zomato coupons.

Family Support: Monthly childcare allowance for women employees.

And Many more…

What You’ll Do? 





 * Write emotionally charged, fast-paced scripts for Hindi microdramas 
ensuring maximum viewer retention and binge-ability.
 * Craft authentic, colloquial dialogues that reflect real-life conversations 
across Hindi-speaking regions — using relatable slang, idioms, and cultural 
references that resonate with mass audiences.
 * Develop cliffhanger-driven episode structures with high emotional peaks 
(drama, romance, revenge, comedy), hooking viewers and driving 
episode-to-episode engagement.
 * Balance emotional storytelling with commercial objectives, while 
maintaining narrative coherence across series arcs.
 * Master "show, don't tell" storytelling — using visual narratives and 
storyboarding to communicate complex emotions and plot twists.
 * Stay sharp on trending microdrama themes, viral plot devices, and regional 
preferences to create content that feels both fresh and familiar.
 * Monitor performance analytics and audience feedback to refine character 
arcs, dialogue style, and narrative hooks in real time.


Who are you?





 * Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree
 * Background in Creative Writing, Literature, Film, Journalism, or related 
fields
 * 3–6 years of content writing in television, OTT, radio, digital publishing, 
or advertising.
 * Native-level proficiency in Hindi with the ability to write across tones — 
from emotional to witty to dramatic.
 * Strong grasp of storytelling techniques, character arcs, and promotional 
beats — especially in Hindi entertainment.
 * Deep understanding of Indian content consumption habits and regional 
preferences.
 * Thrives in fast-paced environments, multitasks well, and delivers quality 
work within tight deadlines.


Where you’ll be?

Location - Remote
